typography.font_family_headings: Didot, Playfair Display, or refined Sans-Serif (Helvetica Neue)
typography.sizing: Small, delicate, premium. No massive shouting text.
typography.whitespace: Generous. Text elements need room to breathe.

header.style: Transparent or Cream background. Slim height.
header.icons: Right aligned (Search, User, Cart, Wishlist). Thin lines.
header.menu_behavior: OFF-CANVAS SLIDE-IN (Left). Width: 25% (Desktop), 100% (Mobile). Secondary Slide-in for subcategories to the right of the main menu.

hero.content: Minimal text (Collection Name). No buttons on image if possible, or very subtle.
hero.autoplay: No autoplay video unless very slow/subtle.

product_grid.gap: Very small (1px) or None. Minimal borders.
product_grid.layout_pattern: BENTO GRID / MIXED HEIGHT. Every 3rd item should be 'Featured' (Span 2 cols, Span 2 rows).
product_grid.card_style: Image dominant. Info block below (White bg). Left: Name. Below: Price. Right: Color dots.

pdp.layout: Split View (Full Height). Left: Gallery (Grid/Scroll). Right: Sticky Info.
pdp.gallery: Large high-res images, full width of the column.
pdp.buttons: Full width 'Add to Cart', minimal style.

cart.layout: Full Page Overlay or Split View. Minimalist List.
cart.style: Clean rows, small images. Prominent but minimal 'Checkout' button.

buttons.default: px-6 py-2 border border-black text-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest
buttons.primary: bg-black text-white hover:bg-neutral-800 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest
